name: gzaat-wordette
description: The Wordette — the daily word game for the Gazette, with the word database behind it

scripts.db:reset: node scripts/wordette-db.mjs init --force && node scripts/wordette-db.mjs import && node scripts/wordette-db.mjs schedule --days 14 --max-difficulty easy && node scripts/wordette-db.mjs schedule --days 1811 && node scripts/wordette-db.mjs export
